😼 Dogecoin Foundation launches official DOGE reserve 

The Dogecoin Foundation has created the “Official Dogecoin Reserve” under a new corporate structure called House of Doge. To kick things off, they’ve already acquired 10 million DOGE worth $1.8 million. https://t.co/aklJBwvCmB
